methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly with mock copy_from_env injecting synthetic result JSONs. Two do-nothing scenarios tested per Lesson 24.

do_nothing_no_export.description: copy_from_env raises FileNotFoundError (agent did nothing, export never ran)

do_nothing_baseline.description: Export ran but all fields at initial state (user_found=false, role_found=false, data_rule_found=false)

partial_no_assignment.description: User gis_reader and role ROLE_GIS_READER created, but no role assignment and no ACL rules configured

full_success.description: All criteria met: user gis_reader created + ROLE_GIS_READER role created + user assigned to role + data ACL rule for ne.*.r + WMS service security rule

notes: Tests GeoServer security REST API: /rest/security/usergroup/users.json, /rest/security/roles.json, /rest/security/acl/layers.json, /rest/security/acl/services.json. Flexible matching on ACL rule key/value.
verification_method: export_result.sh -> /tmp/access_control_configuration_result.json -> copy_from_env -> JSON field parsing against GeoServer security REST API responses
